name: my-external-docker
description: Example: Docker Desktop data on an external drive via APFS sparsebundle.
notes: Create the sparsebundle once: hdiutil create -size 200g -type SPARSEBUNDLE -fs APFS -volname DockerData /Volumes/MyDrive/DockerData.sparsebundle
ExFAT/NTFS alone cannot host Docker.raw reliably; use APFS image or an APFS partition.
